interpretation: Illustrative synthetic upper crust, not an observed or calibrated site model
section_sampling: Analytic field at exact central planes, 100-m in-plane pixel centres
scaling_note: Fixed-centre spatial dilation; basin/fault/fabric anchored at surface; features clipped by unchanged domain

features.basin: Undulating sediment/basement contact; deepest near (7, 4.4) km; additional thickness factor 1
features.fault: Oblique curved corridor dipping about 65 degrees; additional thickness factor 1; up to -0.72 km/s
features.alteration: Tilted low-Vp lens centred at (10.216, 4.8, 3.8) km; -0.54 km/s peak
features.intrusion: Tilted mafic body centred at (15.0, 3.8, 4.8) km; unchanged size and +0.72 km/s peak
features.fabric: 18 deterministic sinusoidal modes; wavelengths doubled; nominal RMS 0.0525 km/s
